Network Solutions

Secure wired, wireless and remote-access networks with policy-based access control.

How we deliver it

We design segmented networks, firewalls and wireless that follow least privilege. Who and what connects is decided by identity and device posture, not just a password.

  1. Assess: topology, capacity, wireless surveys and risks
  2. Design: segmentation, firewalls, VPN and zero-trust access
  3. Deploy: configure, test and document
  4. Audit: periodic security reviews and rule clean-up

Outcomes

  • Only trusted users and devices connect
  • Segmented networks limit the blast radius
  • Documented, auditable configuration
